quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Electron annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Business environment (management's view): strong AI demand has tightened supply and demand for high-performance semiconductor devices and device prices tend to be rising, but the company expects the supply-demand balance to settle over the medium to long term; it expects the semiconductor market to keep growing as applications such as AI servers and robotics broaden, and the semiconductor production equipment business to grow significantly. It will watch for supply-chain disruption if Middle East tensions are prolonged.

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Electron annual securities report: FY2026 (06-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management plan targets for the fiscal year ending March 2027: net sales of JPY 3 trillion or more, operating margin of 35% or more and ROE of 30% or more, to be reached by supplying new products and services to both semiconductor scaling and advanced packaging, based on what the company calls the industry's largest shipment record (cumulative 100,000+ units) and patent portfolio (26,000+). Five-year growth investment plan from the fiscal year ended March 2025: R&D investment of JPY 1.5 trillion or more and capex of JPY 700 billion or more (five-year cumulative), and about 10,000 hires globally.

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expense JPY 277,866 million (+11.1%), 11.4% of consolidated net sales (+1.1 points). R&D themes: coater/developers, etch, deposition, cleaning, advanced-packaging process systems and wafer probers for next-generation devices; process optimization for ultra-high-resolution EUV patterning and complex structures such as 3D stacked memory; high-NA EUV resist material technology, multi-patterning, new-material deposition, etch, thermal processing and cleaning; strengthened process-integration evaluation across the whole process module from the transistor to the interconnect steps; and Epsira, a new DX solution concept for equipment and field productivity.
